diagrams.title: Same answer, two designs
diagrams.caption: Same answer, two designs. On the left the model is both the measuring instrument and the narrator, so the measurement wobbles. On the right the measurement is code the company owns, and the model is only asked to do what it is genuinely good at — explaining.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 880 270" aria-label="Two panels. Left: the same answer graded three times by the LLM alone returns 2, 4 and 3 filler words. Right: the same answer passed through the detect_filler_words tool returns 4 every time, and the LLM only writes the feedback." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

        <text x="68" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="11" fill="currentColor">answer</text>
        <g stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" fill="none" opacity=".75">
          <path d="M116,135 C190,80 240,80 300,80"></path>
          <path d="M116,135 L300,135"></path>

        </g>

          <rect x="300" y="62" width="104" height="36" rx="2" fill="#A52A38"></rect><text x="352" y="85" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF">run 1 → 2</text>
          <rect x="300" y="117" width="104" height="36" rx="2" fill="#A52A38"></rect><text x="352" y="140" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF">run 2 → 4</text>
          <rect x="300" y="172" width="104" height="36" rx="2" fill="#A52A38"></rect><text x="352" y="195" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF">run 3 → 3</text>

        <text x="212" y="248" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="currentColor" opacity=".68">three runs, three “facts” — none of them defensible</text>
        <line x1="440" y1="14" x2="440" y2="256" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" opacity=".22"></line>
        <text x="462" y="26" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="11.5" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="1.2" fill="currentColor">LLM + TOOL</text>
        <text x="462" y="46" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="currentColor" opacity=".62">The model calls detect_filler_words(answer)</text>
        <rect x="462" y="112" width="96" height="46" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"></rect>
        <text x="510" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="11" fill="currentColor">answer</text>
        <line x1="558" y1="135" x2="596" y2="135" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"></line>
        <rect x="596" y="113" width="112" height="44" rx="2" fill="#2B3A67"></rect>
        <text x="652" y="133" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10.5" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">tool</text>
        <text x="652" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".8">total: 4</text>
        <line x1="708" y1="135" x2="744" y2="135" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"></line>
        <rect x="744" y="113" width="114" height="44" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1B6B4C" stroke-width="1.5"></rect>
        <text x="801" y="133" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10.5" font-weight="600" fill="#1B6B4C">LLM writes</text>
        <text x="801" y="148" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10" fill="#1B6B4C">the feedback</text>
        <text x="660" y="206" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="11" fill="currentColor">4 · 4 · 4 · 4 · 4 …</text>
        <text x="660" y="248" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="currentColor" opacity=".68">the number is policy; only the prose varies</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: The solid arrows are one evaluated answer
diagrams.caption: The solid arrows are one evaluated answer. The dashed arrow is the meta-question path: `ask_agent()` reads the whole session log and goes through the *same* loop, so the model can still call a tool (usually `generate_final_report`) while answering “how am I doing?”.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 980 360" aria-label="Architecture. The Gradio app and the CLI main.py both call run_turn. run_turn calls run_loop, which exchanges messages with the Groq model; when the model requests tools, run_loop executes them from the tool table and sends results back. run_turn appends the question, answer and tool results to session_log. ask_agent and generate_final_report both read session_log." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs>
          <marker id="a7" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="currentColor"></path></marker>
        </defs>
